decks.notes: This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's mana base while controlling the board with removal spells and powerful creatures. By using cards like Boom / Bust and Cleansing Wildfire, the deck aims to destroy the opponent's lands and prevent them from developing their board. The deck also includes versatile cards like Prismatic Ending and Lightning Helix for removal and life gain. With powerful finishers like Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines and Solitude, the deck can quickly close out the game once it has stabilized the board state.

The main concept of this deck is to use Underworld Breach in combination with cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, Mishra's Bauble, and Ledger Shredder to continuously cast spells from the graveyard and generate value. The deck aims to quickly fill the graveyard, utilize card draw effects like Expressive Iteration, and control the board with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Spell Snare and Teferi, Time Raveler to protect the combo and interact with the opponent. The overall strategy is to assemble the combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with quick, powerful plays.

This deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures while utilizing cascade effects to quickly deploy high-impact spells like Crashing Footfalls and Violent Outburst. By cascading into these spells, the deck can create a board presence that is difficult for the opponent to deal with. The inclusion of cards like Blood Moon and Magus of the Moon also disrupt the opponent's mana base, further increasing the deck's advantage. Overall, the deck focuses on generating tempo and pressure to secure quick victories.

The deck focuses on quickly casting spells with Cascade, particularly Crashing Footfalls, to overwhelm the opponent with token creatures. It includes various disruptive elements like Force of Negation and Brazen Borrower to control the board while applying pressure. The use of cards like Shardless Agent and Arcane Proxy help ensure consistent cascades, while cards like Teferi, Time Raveler provide additional disruption. The deck aims to win the game quickly by overwhelming the opponent with a large number of threats while disrupting their game plan.

The deck is focused on using creatures with sacrifice effects to assemble powerful synergies and combos, aiming to generate value and win the game through a toolbox approach. Cards like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide are key pieces that can help control the board and generate advantage. The deck also includes mana dorks and creature tutors to assemble the pieces needed for the combo. The main strategy revolves around sacrificing creatures for various effects while also applying pressure on the opponent's life total.

The main concept of this deck is to assemble the CopyCat combo, which involves using Saheeli Rai's -2 ability to create a copy of Felidar Guardian, allowing you to repeatedly blink Felidar Guardian and generate infinite hasty 1/4 Cat tokens. This combo can quickly overwhelm your opponent and win the game in just a few turns. The deck also includes powerful cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Omnath, Locus of Creation to control the game and generate additional value. Overall, the goal is to efficiently execute the combo while disrupting your opponent's game plan.

The deck focuses on utilizing Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty early in the game. The deck also includes cards like Bitter Reunion and Persist to fill up the graveyard and enable more creative plays. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Inquisition of Kozilek and Spell Pierce while also packing removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Prismari Command. The mana base is optimized to facilitate the combo pieces and ensure consistent plays throughout the game.

This deck focuses on utilizing Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Indomitable Creativity to bring out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Wrenn and Six quickly. It also includes control elements like Spell Pierce and Lightning Bolt to protect the combo pieces. The deck aims to create a strong board presence and control the game through its unique combo interactions. The inclusion of Prismari Command and Fire/Ice provides additional versatility and interaction with the opponent's board. The mana base allows for consistent access to the necessary colors for the combo pieces.

This deck is focused on using the combination of Indomitable Creativity and Leyline Binding to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. By utilizing cards like Prismari Command and Teferi, Time Raveler for control and disruption, the deck aims to assemble its combo pieces quickly while maintaining board presence. The inclusion of cards like Wrenn and Six and Persist provide additional value and recursion. The mana base is tuned to support the deck's color requirements and ensure consistency in casting its spells.

This deck focuses on combining Elemental creatures with powerful control spells to disrupt opponents and maintain board control. It utilizes cards like Risen Reef and Smokebraider to generate advantage and ramp into bigger threats like Omnath, Locus of Creation. With cards like Solitude and Teferi, Time Raveler for removal and disruption, it aims to control the game until it can overwhelm the opponent with its Elemental synergies. The inclusion of lands like Cavern of Souls and Leyline Binding also helps protect its key creatures and spells from disruption.

This deck is focused on utilizing the Goblin tribe to create a fast-paced, aggressive strategy that overwhelms the opponent quickly. With a mix of key Goblin creatures like Mogg War Marshal and Goblin Matron, alongside powerful cards like Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker and Sling-Gang Lieutenant, the deck aims to maintain pressure and momentum throughout the game. The inclusion of Aether Vial helps cheat creatures onto the battlefield quickly, while cards like Munitions Expert and Conspicuous Snoop provide valuable removal and card advantage. Overall, this deck revolves around swarming the opponent with a horde of Goblins to secure victory.

The main strategy of this deck is to swarm the board with Goblin creatures and pump them up with various cards like Goblin Warchief and Rundvelt Hordemaster. Aether Vial helps cheat these creatures into play while cards like Skirk Prospector and Mogg War Marshal generate extra mana and tokens. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast, aggressive plays and use the tribal synergies of Goblins to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent in order to secure a quick victory. The mana base is focused on maximizing the efficiency of the Goblins' abilities and ensuring consistent casting of spells.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on quick and aggressive plays, utilizing efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler. The deck also includes burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Blast to control the board and finish off opponents. With the addition of Mishra's Bauble and Wrenn and Six for card advantage, as well as Urza's Saga for additional value, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents early on and maintain pressure throughout the game.

The main idea of this Hammer Time deck is to quickly equip Colossus Hammer onto a creature, usually Puresteel Paladin or Stoneforge Mystic, to create a powerful threat that can deal massive amounts of damage in a short amount of time. The deck includes a variety of equipment tutors, protection spells, and low-cost creatures to support the combo and provide alternative win conditions. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy that can catch them off guard and secure a swift victory.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively control the game using a combination of efficient counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive creatures. By generating card advantage with cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration, while pressuring the opponent with threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and close out the game quickly. The inclusion of Teferi, Time Raveler also provides additional disruption and protects the deck against opposing control strategies.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with high-value creatures and then bringing them back into play using reanimation spells like Persist and Ephemerate. By combining powerful reanimation effects with disruptive spells like Prismatic Ending and Teferi, Time Raveler, the deck aims to control the game and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures. The key strategy is to quickly assemble the necessary pieces to bring back big threats like Archon of Cruelty and Solitude, while staying alive with life gain from Faithful Mending and Tainted Indulgence.

The deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Tower, Power Plant, and Mine) to ramp into powerful threats like Wurmcoil Engine, Ulamog, and Cityscape Leveler. It also utilizes control elements like Oblivion Stone, Karn Liberated, and Relic of Progenitus to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Lastly, the deck includes a toolbox of artifacts to search for with Karn, the Great Creator, and can utilize Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion for additional value. The strategy is to control the game early and then overwhelm the opponent with big threats in the mid to late game.

This deck focuses on creating a powerful combo using Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle with Primeval Titan and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove to deal massive amounts of damage to the opponent. It also utilizes cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Archon of Cruelty to disrupt the opponent's game plan and maintain control of the board. With support from cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Bitter Reunion, this deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with its powerful synergies.
